title: open-tv-ids record
description: One line of data/<emitter>/series.jsonl: the identifiers of a programme of a catalog in Wikidata, IMDb, TMDB and TVDB, with the evidence the match is based on.

id.description: Global id of the record: the emitter and the id of the work in its catalog.

emitter.description: Catalog the id of the work belongs to.

emitterId.description: Id of the work in the catalog of the emitter (programatv_id in 3Cat).

kind.description: Kind of work, in ASCII. It is the category of the emitter translated, not the type of Wikidata.

title.description: Title of the work in the catalog of the emitter, in the language of the catalog.

originalTitle.description: Original title, only when the catalog publishes one and it differs from the local one.

availableSince.description: Day the oldest video of the work available in the catalog was published. It is the date of the catalog, not the premiere of the work: a licensed series of 2015 can be filed under 2025.

ids.description: Identifiers of the work, keyed by catalog.

wikidata.description: Item of Wikidata (P345 of the item, read from the article of a Wikipedia).

tmdb.description: TMDB id: the id of the TV series (P4983) or, for a film, the id of the film (P4947).

sources.description: Where the record comes from, so a consumer can check it.

method.description: wikidata when the matcher found it, manual when a person corrected it in overrides/<emitter>.json.

confidence.description: Confidence of the match, from 0 to 1. The dataset publishes from 0.90.

verified.description: Whether a second, independent source confirms the identifiers.

firstSeen.description: Day the record was published for the first time.
